name: electerm-ai-auth-widget-example
description: An electerm widget that signs in to a ChatGPT or SuperGrok subscription in its own panel and exposes it as a local OpenAI Responses endpoint.
author: ZHAO Xudong

electerm.name: AI subscription proxy
electerm.description: Sign in to a ChatGPT or SuperGrok subscription in this panel, then apply the AI settings it offers.
electerm.author: ZHAO Xudong

configs.name: provider
configs.label: Provider
configs.description: Which subscription the proxy forwards to. One proxy serves one provider.

configs.name: port
configs.label: Local port
configs.description: The proxy listens on 127.0.0.1 at this port. Change it only if 8788 is taken; the URL in electerm's AI config has to match.

configs.name: upstreamProxy
configs.label: Upstream proxy
configs.description: Proxy for sign-in and API calls (http://... or socks5://...). Leave empty to use HTTPS_PROXY, then the system proxy (the one a VPN sets), then a direct connection. electerm's own AI Proxy is cleared by 'Use these settings' because this endpoint is local.
